# Mei Koh
mei.koh@example.test | +65 6000 0093 | Singapore

## SUMMARY
Results-oriented Technology Associate with proven experience in solution architecture, AWS, and REST APIs. Proven ability to translate business needs into reliable, maintainable solutions while managing complex stakeholder requirements. Adept at defining integration patterns, facilitating architecture decisions, and delivering clear technical documentation. Seeking to leverage transferable skills as a Mid-level Solutions Architect at Example Harbour Digital to drive quality, reliability, and responsible delivery.

## EXPERIENCE

**Technology Associate** | Example Cedar Innovations (Singapore)
*Jul 2023 – Present*

*   **Solution Design & Translation:** Translate operational and customer needs into robust solution designs using AWS and solution architecture principles, improving team turnaround by 12%.
*   **Integration & Security:** Define integration and security patterns utilizing REST APIs; document all architectural decisions for technical and business reviewers to ensure clarity and auditability.
*   **Stakeholder Management:** Collaborate with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to facilitate architecture decisions and communicate progress, risks, and trade-offs during fortnightly reviews.
*   **Delivery & Quality Control:** Manage approximately 59 work items monthly while enforcing quality checks and follow-up actions to ensure evidence-based decision-making and reliable delivery.

**Technical Assistant** | Example Delta Operations (Singapore)
*Jan 2021 – Jun 2023*

*   **Microservices Support:** Supported recurring operational workflows involving microservices, ensuring system stability and maintainability.
*   **Documentation & Process Improvement:** Created clear step-by-step documentation for service requests; developed a reporting template that reduced manual preparation time by 7%.
*   **Issue Resolution:** Investigated service requests and escalated complex issues with clear supporting evidence, demonstrating ability to solve ambiguous problems collaboratively.

## PROJECTS

**Solutions Architect Practice Project**
*   Designed and built a demonstration project leveraging AWS, solution architecture, and REST APIs.
*   Executed representative testing scenarios to validate design limitations and define next steps.
*   Presented final design outcomes and trade-offs to a five-person peer review group, honing communication skills for technical audiences.

## EDUCATION

**Bachelor of Science in Information Systems** | Example Institute of Technology (Singapore)
*Aug 2020 – May 2024*
*   Relevant Coursework: Software Engineering, Databases, Cybersecurity, and Applied Analytics.

## SKILLS

*   **Architecture:** Solution Architecture, System Integration, Microservices Design.
*   **Cloud & APIs:** AWS (Certified Cloud Practitioner), REST APIs, Terraform.
*   **Soft Skills:** Stakeholder Management, Technical Documentation, Clear Verbal/Written Communication, Collaborative Problem Solving.
*   **Tools:** Git, Excel, Jira/Work Item Tracking.

## CERTIFICATIONS

*   AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner

# Solutions Architect



**Company:** Example Harbour Digital (fictional)  

**Location:** Singapore  

**Employment type:** Full-time  

**Seniority:** Mid



## ABOUT THE ROLE



Example Harbour Digital is seeking a Solutions Architect to join a multidisciplinary technology team. The successful

candidate will turn operational and customer needs into reliable, maintainable solutions. This role

works closely with engineering, product and business stakeholders, values clear documentation and

expects evidence-based decisions. The position offers ownership of meaningful work while maintaining

appropriate review, security and quality controls.



## RESPONSIBILITIES



* Translate business needs into solution designs.

* Define integration and security patterns.

* Facilitate architecture decisions.

* Support delivery teams.

* Communicate trade-offs to technical and business stakeholders.

* Communicate progress, risks and technical trade-offs to relevant stakeholders.

* Maintain clear documentation and contribute to team planning and reviews.



## REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



* solution architecture

* AWS

* REST APIs

* microservices

* security

* technical documentation

* stakeholder management

* system integration

* Clear written and verbal communication

* Ability to work collaboratively and solve ambiguous problems



## PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



* Terraform

* Kubernetes

* cost optimisation



## WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



In the first six months, the successful candidate will understand the existing environment, deliver

well-tested improvements and build trusted working relationships. Success is measured through

quality, reliability, responsible delivery and useful outcomes rather than activity alone.
